## Description

Validation properties (volume, surface area, centroid) emitted with measure units that don't match the model's `GEOMETRIC_REPRESENTATION_CONTEXT` — or with no `unit_component` at all.

## Reproducer recipe

XCAF with validation properties exported in non-mm units while geometry GRC is mm; or `MEASURE_REPRESENTATION_ITEM` with no `unit_component` reference.

## Expected kernel behavior

emit / validate same unit on validation properties as on geometry; require `unit_component` to be present and consistent.
